fields.before: The synthetic “painting” of the chandelier is generated either by tracing a lens image (small hand error, optionally patched together from slightly different lens positions) or by constructing it by eye. Open circles are the painted points; blue dots show the best single projection; thin lines are the misfit, magnified. The histogram collects 200 paintings of each kind: painters differ in skill, so the histograms have width: when the assumed unaided accuracy is close to the tracer's, they overlap and the misfit of one painting says little about its method.
